Brief Description

Click Here Labs is a full-service, independent digital agency based in Dallas and part of the TRG family. Our expertise spans multiple channels, including website, mobile, social, email, online ad units, AR, VR, AI, and other emerging technologies. This internship is designed to give you real experience in a professional agency environment.

What You'll Be Doing



- Work alongside our development team on real client and internal projects, contributing code that goes into production
- Build and maintain websites using platforms like WordPress, Webflow, and custom front-end solutions (React, HTML/CSS/JS)
- Use AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow
- Write documentation for your work, including READMEs and Wiki entries
- Participate in code reviews, team standups, and knowledge-sharing sessions
- Learn agency workflows including project management tools, version control, and client communication practices

What You're Good At



- A foundation in web development fundamentals: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
- Exposure to at least one modern framework or CMS (React, Vue, WordPress, Webflow, Drupal, or similar)
- Curiosity about AI and a willingness to use AI tools in your development process
- The ability to take direction well, ask questions when you are stuck, and follow through on tasks
- Clear communication in writing and conversation
- Self-motivation and time management across multiple tasks
- Attention to detail and care for the quality of your work

What You Have In Your Background



- Currently pursuing or have recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Web Development, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent self-taught/bootcamp experience)
- A portfolio, personal projects, or GitHub profile that demonstrates your development skills
- Familiarity with Git and version control basics
- Bonus: Any experience with MCPs or AI-assisted development

Co-Op: Data Engineer

 Organization: IT & Data, Chief Data Office US
 Location: United States, hybrid
 Employment Type: College Co-Op

 Job Mission
 As a Data Engineer Co-Op at ASML, you will help develop data pipelines and data products that transform laser-machine and enterprise data into trusted, usable information.
 Working with experienced data engineers, data architects, IT specialists, and business stakeholders, you will contribute to technical solutions that support product capabilities, analytics, AI, system performance, and ultimately customer satisfaction.
 This role provides an opportunity to work with complex, high-value data in a collaborative engineering environment while learning how modern data solutions are designed, tested, deployed, documented, and operated at enterprise scale.

 Job Description
 As a member of the CDO US team, you will:
 
• Develop and enhance data pipeline solutions that contribute to product features, technical roadmaps, analytics, and AI use cases. 
• Build data ingestion, transformation, validation, and integration processes for laser-machine and enterprise data. 
• Contribute to automated continuous data integration pipelines used to build, test, and release data solutions. 
• Develop and optimize SQL transformations, data models, and analytical datasets. 
• Apply systematic problem-solving to identify root causes, resolve technical issues, and standardize reusable solutions. 
• Collaborate with cross-functional engineering and business teams on system design changes and improvements to system performance. 
• Work with business users to understand requirements and translate business goals into feasible technical solutions. 
• Collaborate with data architects, software engineers, AI engineers, and IT team members to achieve shared project goals. 
• Help improve data quality, observability, monitoring, lineage, and governance. 
• Apply industry practices for code quality, automated testing, version control, maintainability, and technical documentation. 
• Refactor and improve existing code so that legacy and modern systems can coexist during technology transitions. 
• Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, agile delivery activities, and continuous improvement. 
• Document data pipelines, interfaces, data models, decisions, dependencies, and operating procedures. 
• Contribute reusable data components and engineering patterns that can support multiple teams and use cases. 
 Education and Experience
 
• Must be pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
• Knowledge of or experience with Python, SQL, Java, or a comparable programming language. 
• Knowledge of relational databases, data modeling, and data integration concepts. 
• Familiarity with Databricks, SQL Server, or other database and data-platform technologies. 
• Familiarity with Microsoft Azure or another cloud environment. 
• Exposure to ETL/ELT development, data pipelines, or analytical data processing. 
• Academic, personal, or professional project experience performing data engineering or similar work. 
• Familiarity with Git, automated testing, CI/CD, or modern software-development practices is preferred. 
• Experience with data quality, pipeline monitoring, or data visualization is a plus. 
 Skills and Competencies
 
• Strong customer focus and a commitment to customer satisfaction through quality, prioritization, efficiency, and professionalism. 
• Strong numerical, analytical, and structured problem-solving skills. 
• Ability to decompose complex problems, clarify requirements, and propose feasible solutions. 
• Attention to detail and the ability to complete assignments with a high degree of accuracy. 
• Ownership and accountability for assigned work, including raising risks and following through on commitments. 
• Ability to perform effectively in a demanding environment with changing priorities and workloads. 
• Open, clear, concise, and professional communication. 
• Ability to establish cooperative working relationships with colleagues, technical teams, and business stakeholders. 
• Willingness to seek feedback, learn new technologies, and continuously improve. 
• Understanding of the importance of code health, testing, maintainability, and documentation. 
• Ability to balance immediate delivery needs with the development of scalable and reusable solutions. 
 What Success Looks Like
 During the co-op, you will have the opportunity to:
 
• Deliver working data pipelines, transformations, or data products that contribute to real business or engineering outcomes. 
• Improve the quality, reliability, accessibility, or maintainability of data used by internal teams. 
• Demonstrate disciplined engineering through testing, documentation, code reviews, and version control. 
• Translate a defined business or engineering need into a practical technical solution. 
• Collaborate effectively across data, IT, engineering, analytics, and AI teams. 
• Develop reusable solutions rather than addressing each technical problem in isolation. 
• Build practical experience with enterprise data platforms, cloud technology, and production-oriented engineering. 
 Team Culture
 The CDO US team works across organizational and technical boundaries to turn data into scalable business and engineering value. We are looking for a student who:
 
• Is curious about how data supports advanced engineering, analytics, AI, and customer outcomes. 
• Takes ownership while remaining comfortable asking questions and seeking guidance. 
• Approaches problems systematically and looks for root causes, not only immediate fixes. 
• Values collaboration over individual heroics. 
• Communicates openly about progress, risks, dependencies, and lessons learned. 
• Cares about data quality, code quality, documentation, and long-term maintainability. 
• Can adapt as priorities change without losing focus on quality and delivery. 
• Looks for opportunities to standardize, automate, and reuse solutions. 
• Is motivated by learning and contributing in a highly technical, international environment. 
 Inclusion and diversity 
 ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company.
 
 Need to know more about applying for a job at ASML? Read our frequently asked questions .
fit_why: Data pipelines, SQL, Python/Java fit; strong overlap with his experience

15000 Valmont Plaza Omaha Nebraska 68154 
 
 Why Valmont 
 
 We’re Here to Move the World Forward. 
 Valmont impacts millions of people around the world every day, yet they might not realize the many ways. Our technology is helping feed the growing population, supplying the world with more reliable energy and access to renewables, enhancing connectivity in remote and urban locations to create a sustainable future and so much more. Simply put, Valmont is advancing agricultural productivity and reimagining vital infrastructure to make life better. 
   
 Join a Fortune 1000 company that respects hard work, honors diversity and invests in our employees as we focus on creating the world of tomorrow, today . We are the modern workforce . Are you ready to move the world forward? Apply now. 

 Location: Omaha, NE | Start Date: Spring 2027

 A Brief Summary of This Position: 

 At Valmont, we believe a career here is a career with a future! As a global leader in agriculture and infrastructure, we design solutions that help our customers grow smarter and work more efficiently.

 As an AI and Data Engineering Intern within Valmont’s Agriculture Division Software Engineering Department, you’ll play an important role in advancing data-driven decision-making and irrigation optimization. You’ll gain hands-on experience working with cloud-based data systems, developing predictive models, and collaborating with engineering and product teams to deliver impactful data insights.

 Valmont’s internship program provides a hands-on learning experience through project work, leadership development, job shadowing, and interaction with senior leaders across the company.

 What You’ll Do: 

• Extract, clean, and preprocess data from Azure-based databases 
• Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities 
• Engineer features for predictive modeling and decision-making 
• Develop and evaluate machine learning models to support irrigation optimization 
• Document methodologies, findings, and present insights to key stakeholders 
• Collaborate with engineering and product teams to integrate data solutions 
• Identify data quality issues and propose process improvements 
 What We’re Looking For: 

• Junior, Senior, or recent graduate pursuing a degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field 
• Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and manipulation 
• Strong programming skills in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib/Seaborn) 
• Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure 
• Strong experience in data cleaning, feature engineering, and model development, with the ability to interpret data, solve problems analytically, and translate findings into actionable insights 
• Experience working with time-series or sensor data, particularly in agriculture or environmental contexts, is preferred 
• Familiarity with geospatial analysis tools such as GeoPandas or QGIS is preferred 
• Understanding of precision agriculture, irrigation systems, or agronomy preferred 
• Exposure to MLOps practices and deploying machine learning models in production environments is preferred 
• Experience with dashboarding and data visualization tools like Power BI, Tableau, or Plotly Dash preferred 
• Ability to work in the office, either Tuesday or Thursday 
 What You’ll Gain :

• Paid internship with meaningful, career-related work experience 
• Tuition assistance and other benefits available based on hours worked 
• Part-time during the academic year, full-time and flexible in the summer, with potential for a full-time position post-graduation 
• A supportive culture focused on learning and growth 
• Opportunities to collaborate with intern peers and company leaders 
 
 Benefits 
 Valmont offers employees and their families a comprehensive Total Wellbeing benefit package to ensure their individual and family’s overall wellness needs are met. Some offerings are dependent upon the role, work schedule, or location and can include the following:
 
• Healthcare (medical, prescription drugs, dental and vision)
 
• 401k retirement plan with company match
 
• Paid time off
 
• Employer paid life insurance
 
• Employer paid short-term and long-term disability including maternity leave
 
• Work Life Support
 
• Tuition Reimbursement up to $5,250 per year
 
• Voluntary programs like tobacco cessation, Type 2 diabetes reversal, one-on-one health coaching, mortgage services and more
 
 Valmont does not discriminate against any employee or applicant in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by law.  Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 If you have a disability and require any assistance in filling out the application for employment email EEOCompliance@Valmont.com.

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. Regeneron is currently seeking multiple 2027 Interns in AI/ML & Data Engineering teams. These teams build the AI tools, data pipelines, and machine learning systems that help Regeneron develop medicines faster and reduce manual work. 

 These positions offer the opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, science-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.  
   
 When & where: 
 Location: Tarrytown, NY / Warren, NJ / Armonk, NY / Cambridge, MA / Sleepy Hollow, NY 
 Timeframe: Our internship positions are full-time from May/June-August; most are onsite, and some roles are hybrid 
 Pay : Intern and Co-op pay ranges are determined by level of education (year in school) and degree program. The hourly rate range for these locations is: $17.90-$50.90 per hour. 
   
 What you'll do: 
 
• Build and test AI solutions that are used on real systems — not shadow projects. 
• Projects may include building AI agents and LLM-powered applications, mining text with natural language processing, building and modernizing data pipelines and semantic data models, evaluating and validating AI tools and models, and automating routine workflows with AI-assisted coding tools. 
• Expect hands-on software and data engineering, working with scientists and business teams to understand the problem, and responsible, well-governed use of AI. 
• Python, SQL, and software engineering fundamentals are typically expected, along with familiarity with LLM prompting or machine learning packages. Several projects are better suited to master's students. 
 Relevant majors: Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Bioinformatics, Information Technology, Mathematics, Biomedical Engineering

About Marvell 
 Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. 
 
 At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. 
 
 Your Team, Your Impact 
 
Marvell’s Compute and Custom Solutions (CCS) organization is seeking a talented Data Scientist Intern to join our Business Automation team. Our team applies data science, AI, and intelligent automation to improve business processes, increase efficiency, and enable better data-driven decision-making across CCS. We partner with business and technical teams to analyze data, develop predictive capabilities, and create innovative solutions to real-world business challenges. 
 What You Can Expect 
 As an intern, you will contribute directly to a data science project focused on transforming historical business data into predictive insights. You can also expect to:

• Clean and prepare historical business data for analysis and machine learning, identifying and resolving data quality issues, inconsistencies, and missing values. 
• Analyze historical datasets to identify trends, relationships, outliers, and features that may contribute to predictive performance. 
• Develop and train machine learning models using Python and established data science libraries to predict business outcomes based on historical data. 
• Evaluate and compare modeling approaches using appropriate statistical and machine learning techniques to assess accuracy and reliability. 
• Document and present the methodology, model performance, findings, and recommendations to the Business Automation team and business stakeholders. 
 What We're Looking For 
 Minimum Requirements: 
 
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field, with an expected graduation date between Fall 2027 and Summer 2028. 
• Proficiency in Python for data processing, analysis, and machine learning, including experience with libraries such as pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn. 
• Strong foundation in statistics, exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and machine learning fundamentals. 
• Experience working with structured datasets and using SQL to query, manipulate, and analyze data. 
• Ability to analyze technical results and clearly communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 Preferred Requirements: 
 
• Experience developing and evaluating predictive models using techniques such as regression, classification, decision trees, random forests, or gradient boosting. 
• Experience developing and evaluating predictive models using modern and classical techniques such as LLM inference, embedding models, SVM, or XGBoost. 
• Familiarity with Git or similar source-control and collaborative development tools. 
• Prior academic, research, or project experience using real-world datasets to develop machine learning or predictive analytics solutions. 
 
 Expected Base Pay Range (USD) 
29 - 57, $ per hour. 
 The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.
 


 Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements   
Marvell is committed to providing exceptional, comprehensive benefits that support our employees at every stage - from internship to retirement and through life’s most important moments. Our offerings are built around four key pillars: financial well-being, family support, mental and physical health, and recognition. Highlights for our interns: medical, dental, and vision coverage, perks and discounts, robust mental health resources to prioritize emotional well-being, and paid holidays. Additional compensation may be available for intern PhD candidates. We look forward to sharing more with you during the interview process. 
 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. 
 
 Any applicant who requires a reasonable accommodation during the selection process should contact Marvell HR Helpdesk at TAOps@marvell.com . 
 
 Interview Integrity  
 To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.
 
 These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.
 
 This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.
